gpu_concurrency: One study GPU at a time; existing production services untouched. Prior application workers must retire before the next job.

optimized_native.native_extensions: causal-conv1d 1.7.0 built from source; fla-core 0.5.2; SDPA and original model attention semantics retained
optimized_native.comparison: same-image, same-container native vs experimental DFIP; randomized order; nine v1 workloads; 50 warm calls after four admission calls
optimized_native.fidelity: round zero: 2000 typed questions and 1024 derived BANKING77 decisions; changing-shape trace in every completed round
optimized_native.statistics: paired bootstrap over container medians, never pooled with v1

released_compiler.fidelity: 128 changing-content/length/candidate-width requests; all probabilities compared; not a task-quality benchmark

serving.modes: native vs experimental production for Decider/Clef; native serialized vs concurrent dispatch to the native SGLang scheduler for Security-One
serving.arrivals: fixed open-loop 5, 15 and 30 requests/s, each for 60 seconds; completely drained between phases
serving.client: external author workstation in Sweden; authenticated Modal RPC
serving.payloads: deterministically changing state contents, recurring lengths, candidate widths 2/8/16; one choice question per request
serving.server: one GPU, max_containers=1, 64 concurrent RPC inputs; Transformer GPU execution serialized with a lock; separate Security-One concurrent-dispatch mode allows native SGLang scheduling/batching
serving.overload: 128 client requests in flight; excess arrivals counted as dropped; errors retained, not removed from denominator
serving.latency: scheduled arrival to received result; includes client dispatch lag, external transport and queueing; excludes cold setup
serving.fidelity: 128 matched requests before/after each mode plus archived returned distributions throughout traffic
serving.limitations: Minute-scale bounded soak, not hours-long reliability validation; single external client geography; not a throughput ceiling for dynamic-batching engines; no invoice reconciliation
